title: Stanislaus National Forest Announces the 'BIGFOOT IN YOUR BACKYARD!' Presentation Is Now On Video
excerpt: Stanislaus National Forest Announces the ‘BIGFOOT IN YOUR BACKYARD!’ Presentation Is Now On Video
content:
Details Last Updated: Monday, 19 October 2026 04:10 Published: Monday, 19 October 2026 05:15

October 19, 2026 - When the Stanislaus National Forest hosted its presentation on Bigfoot, the crowd was so large that many people had to be turned away. Organizers promised that a video would be made available — and **Access Tuolumne is happy to deliver!**

Did you know that Tuolumne County ranks second in California for reported Bigfoot sightings?

From mysterious encounters along Highway 108 to traditional Miwok stories about giants near Table Mountain and Columbia, our own backyard has a surprisingly rich history of Sasquatch lore.

In this fascinating presentation, Stanislaus National Forest staff explore historical newspaper accounts, alleged sightings, mysterious footprints, unusual recordings, and the cultural traditions surrounding Bigfoot. And don't miss the audience members who share their own extraordinary experiences in the Sierra Nevada!

Whether you're a believer, a skeptic, or just curious about our local history, this is an entertaining journey into one of the Sierra's most enduring mysteries.

**Watch the presentation here:**

https://media.accesstuolumne.org/internetchannel/show/7106

And tell us in the comments: **Have YOU ever seen or heard something in the Sierra Nevada you couldn't explain?**

Source: Stanislaus National Forest
